pages.title: Non-destructive glow groups
pages.description: Your glow now lives in a layer group. Add masks, blend tweaks or extra layers to the group — they survive every re-render.

pages.title: Colorize + Deep Saturation
pages.description: Tint the glow any color with COLORIZE, or dial SATURATION from a pure white bloom all the way to the image's own colors.

pages.title: Exclude Colors
pages.description: Pick any combination of color swatches and suppress each from the glow at its own strength.
